title: CV Tailor
excerpt: An agentic Claude Code skill that turns any job description into a tailored, ATS-friendly LaTeX CV — grounded strictly in your verified experience files, with honesty rules that refuse to fabricate.
body:
## Overview

Ask an LLM to "tailor my CV for this job posting" and you get two failure modes at once: generic templates that ignore the job description, and confident fabrication — invented metrics, claimed-but-unused technologies, inflated titles. CV Tailor is an agentic skill for Claude Code (a `SKILL.md` pipeline any AI agent can execute) designed against both: it produces a genuinely tailored, ATS-friendly LaTeX CV **where every bullet traces back to a source file you control**.

## The Pipeline

```
job description (URL or text)
        │
        ▼
1–3  fetch JD · read your resource library · extract seniority/stack/culture signals
        ▼
4    FIT ASSESSMENT — 3–5 strongest matches, 1–3 honest gaps,
        verdict (Qualified / Stretch / Overqualified) — shown BEFORE any drafting
        ▼
5–8  select bullets (ownership-first, compressed for older roles) · rewrite
        impact-first (XYZ: Outcome → Metric → Mechanism, ≤2 lines) · tailor
        summary to your voice · mirror JD keywords verbatim for ATS
        ▼
9–10  write Markdown + LaTeX · compile (tectonic → pdflatex → xelatex → latexmk)
        · debrief + archive to iCloud (per-company folders, aux files never sync)
```

The structural piece is the **resource library**: experiences live as brag files with structured sections — *What I Did / Impact / Context / Framing Notes* — where framing notes say which angle to emphasize per role type (the same CI/CD project reads as reliability for SRE, cost savings for FinOps). Selection is a real retrieval problem, not generation: the skill picks and re-frames what exists.

## Honesty Rules (the actual feature)

- **No fabricated metrics** — every number traces to `resources/experiences/`; unquantified impact stays descriptive
- **No claimed technologies** you haven't used — missing skills surface as *gaps in the fit assessment*, not as skills
- **No title inflation** — official titles stay; scope shows through ownership verbs
- **Pushes back** — requests to add unverified tools or numbers are refused by design

## Privacy & Tooling

- **Privacy by gitignore**: the repo ships only `*.template.md` skeletons; real contact details, experience files, and brag notes never leave your machine via git
- **Templates**: single-column ATS-friendly LaTeX with `glyphtounicode` (machine-readable PDF), 1–2 page discipline — cut bullets, never shrink fonts; dual-engine (pdfTeX/XeTeX compile identically)
- **Tectonic bootstrap**: `setup.sh` installs a single static LaTeX binary (~30 MB, no sudo) — no TeX Live marathon
architecture:
cv-tailor/
├── SKILL.md              # the skill: 10-step pipeline, modes, honesty rules
├── resources/
│   ├── meta/              # contact · about (voice) · location (templates only in git)
│   ├── educations/        # degrees, honors
│   └── experiences/       # brag files: What I Did / Impact / Context /
│                         #   Framing Notes + YAML meta (featured, overlap_risk)
├── templates/
│   └── ats-friendly-technical-resume/   # LaTeX + Markdown, dual-engine
├── scripts/               # setup.sh (tectonic) · compile.sh · publish-icloud.sh
└── output/                # generated CVs (gitignored → archived to iCloud)
…
